label: Вокруг
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вокруг (around, all around).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: All-around surroundings. 'Вокруг' means all around and works as an adverb here, describing the silence on every side. Standing alone, it paints the whole environment rather than one fixed point.
Strategic focus: Circular motion. 'Вокруг' modifies 'бегали' to show the children running round and round. As a bare adverb it marks movement encircling the area.
Strategic focus: Looking all around. 'Вокруг' modifies 'огляделся' to show the gaze sweeping in every direction. The adverb captures a full visual scan of the surroundings.
Strategic focus: Orbiting motion. Here 'вокруг' acts as a preposition taking the genitive 'солнца', meaning around the sun. It marks a path that circles a central object.
Strategic focus: Encircling location. 'Вокруг' is a preposition with the genitive 'дома', meaning around the house. It places the trees on all sides of a fixed central point.
Strategic focus: Admiring the surroundings. 'Вокруг' is a bare adverb naming everything on every side. Paired with 'красиво', it turns the whole environment into the thing being praised.
Strategic focus: Gathering in a ring. 'Вокруг' is a preposition with the genitive 'гида', meaning around the guide. It shows the tourists forming a circle about the central figure.
Strategic focus: Circling an object. 'Вокруг' is a preposition taking the genitive 'стола', meaning around the table. It marks the cat's path tracing a loop about it.
Strategic focus: Empty surroundings. 'Вокруг' is a bare adverb describing the whole area, here completely deserted. It frames the emptiness extending in all directions.
Strategic focus: Going all the way around. 'Вокруг' is a preposition with the genitive 'озера', meaning around the lake. With 'обошли' it shows a full circuit on foot.
